candidate.definition_en: A form of words used as a magical charm; OR a short period of time.
candidate.explanation_ar: ليها معنيين: تعويذة سحرية زي اللي في القصص، أو فترة زمنية قصيرة 'زي موجة حر'.

senses.definition_en: A continuous short period of a particular condition, activity, or weather.
senses.definition_ar: فترة زمنية قصيرة أو موجة من حالة أو طقس معين.
examples: The dry spell damaged the crops.
We had a spell of hot weather.

senses.definition_en: Spoken words believed to have magical power, or a magical charm.
examples: The wizard recited an ancient spell to unlock the door.
The dry spell damaged the crops.
We had a spell of hot weather.
The wizard recited an ancient spell to unlock the door.
candidate.mnemonic: الساحرة بتعمل 'Spell' 'تعويذة' عشان تسحرك.. وممكن تقول 'Cold spell' يعني موجة برد.
